verdict.rationale: Accounting SaaS can plausibly offer user-configured background automations, so the axis applies, but the evidence shows no such feature. Webhooks, the API, the CLI and MCP are developer building blocks or interactive channels. Subscription recurring billing is a specific billing feature, not a general autonomous-automation capability, so none of these earn credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
